I'll start by reading `TASK.md` and `brief.md` in full so I can follow the brief exactly, with section 0 taking priority.Section 0 points at the T8b decision, both T8b reviews, the T7 bank decision, and the T6 design. I’ll read those next, then the result template.T8b left the bank mismatch and initialization open. I’ll read the inherited rules and the correction-run code before spending any of the six emulator versions.The T8b editor wrote banks 0 and 4 while the accepted reader still uses 1 and 5. I’ll measure both sides under the T8 setup, with the link set by native keys, before changing anything.The release check stopped the proof. The bank measurement and the AF-ON press are in the log, so I am writing the result from those records.The stock editor writes the saved bank, and the reader was using the change bank, one index higher. Reset writes the same half-press image as a fresh start. The reader now uses the saved bank. The proof's AF-ON press matched that bank, and the run then stopped on the release record.

**Q1.** With the link read back as 1 and 1, one Up writes `0x5962` index 0 in landscape, 4 in EXIF 6, and 2 in EXIF 8. With the link read back as 0 and 0, every pose writes index 0. The T6 reader uses 1, 5, 3, and 1. The UI-id table at `0x6062555c` is the same split: UI ids 1338, 1648, and 1646 are the saved indices, and 1339, 1649, and 1647 are the change indices. The ten-byte writer `0x609b3c79` does not read a pose bank.

**Q2.** Initialize All Settings, confirmed with Yes, left every mirrored half-press cell equal to the fresh store. ROM payloads for those keys are 0. Fifty slots differ from the ROM, and on each of them the reset value and the fresh value are the same. `initMirror()` already writes those values, so it was left as it is.

**Change.** `bank()` in `work/scripts/hook_t8c2.mjs` returns the saved index: 0, 4, or 2 when linked, and 0 when not. Labelled EMULATOR-ONLY.

**Proof.** AF-ON entry filled the mirror with the reset image. The edit wrote mirror bank 0 to 292 with zone Small. AF-ON press wrote `[36, 1, 3, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0]`, position 292, Small 1×1, owner 2. Release set owner 0 and wrote `[14, 2, 3, 0, 3, 0, 3, 0, 0, 0]`, position 526 and size 3×3, which is not K1e's pre-press record. The run stopped there, so it did not end `ok: true`. EXIF 6 and the candidate's normal-edit comparison were not run.

`work/result.md` and `work/evidence-manifest.json` are in place. The external seal is `work/evidence-supplement.json`.The bank observation, the reset measurement, and the proof runs have all finished. Their results are already in `work/result.md`.

The stock editor writes the saved bank: index 0, 4, or 2 when orientation link is on, and index 0 when it is off. The reader was using the change bank, one index higher. Reset matches the fresh half-press image, so only the reader was changed. On the proof, the AF-ON press wrote Small at the edited position with owner 2. The release record did not match the stock half-press record, so the run stopped and did not end `ok: true`.
